capabilities: wrap image and video embeds in a CSS grid
fall back to a flexbox layout when no column count is set
configure column count, gap, and a custom grid container id
render an error callout for unsupported file extensions
extras: A Todo section lists unfinished features: media size control and separate row/column gaps. Image autoscaling was intentionally left out to avoid stretching or shrinking media. Installation is via local manual steps only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange multiple media embeds side by side in a grid inside a note.
summary: Renders image and video embeds in a configurable CSS grid or, when no column count is set, a flexbox layout.
